job_text: Example Labs is hiring an Agentic AI Intern in Paris for a six-month internship starting April 2027. Responsibilities include building LangGraph workflows, developing RAG pipelines, integrating LLM APIs and creating evaluation dashboards. Required skills: Python, Git and machine learning fundamentals. Experience with LangChain, FAISS and Docker is preferred.

Northstar Data seeks a full-time Machine Learning Platform Engineer based in Lyon. You will design model-serving APIs, maintain CI/CD pipelines, containerize workloads and monitor production models. Candidates must know Python, FastAPI, SQL and Docker. Kubernetes, Terraform and Google Cloud are nice to have. No start date is specified.

The Center for Language Systems is recruiting an NLP Research Assistant in Montreal on a twelve-month fixed-term contract beginning September 2027. The role involves long-document information retrieval, benchmark construction, error analysis and experiments with transformer models. Required: Python, PyTorch, NLP and experimental rigor. Knowledge of Hugging Face, sentence transformers and retrieval metrics is a plus.
